$comment: Mothrly's character geometry, in one place. Consumed by components/Character.tsx at runtime and by scripts/generate-icon.js at build time, so the app icon and the on-screen character can never drift apart. JSON rather than a .ts module so the Node script can read it with fs.readFileSync and no transpiler. Coordinates are in the viewBox space below. The body path uses only M, C and Z commands — scripts/generate-icon.js parses it to find the silhouette's bounding box and will refuse anything else.
